title: Bug: develop CI red - stale stats --by project and --version specs
description: develop CI has failed since PR #22 (e1073f0). (1) features/cli/80_stats.feature expects 'no project' 4, but PR #21 (codex schema drift) now maps codex project_id from the thread cwd, so the two corpus codex sessions bucket under /workspace/alpha and 'no project' is 2. #22's spec predates #21 and was never rebased. (2) After the v0.2.1 release back-merge, features/cli/00_global.feature still expects 'botspy 0.2.0'. Fix: update both specs to the intended behavior (spec-only change; implementation is correct).
